do: Keep a separate brand-search campaign and exclude brand terms from Performance Max where possible.
dont: Do not let Performance Max absorb branded traffic and call it incremental growth.
why: PMax will happily claim existing brand demand, inflating reported return without adding sales.
source: Google Ads - Performance Max brand traffic guidance

do: Check Merchant Center disapprovals before blaming bids; a disapproved feed cannot serve Shopping ads.
dont: Do not add budget to a campaign whose products are disapproved.
why: Disapprovals are a feed or policy problem, and spend changes do nothing until they clear.
